Commentary.Commentary: ...THE CHASE...

Bangladesh Women will feel they have left 15-20 runs out there. They were around 45 runs inside the first six overs which was a good start as compared to their last game but once the spinners came in, they gave away their wickets by playing some wild shots. There was a rain delay which helped the home team to regroup. Ritu Moni and Murshida Khatun stitched a decent partnership but once Moni fell, Bangladesh crumbled down. Now they have a tough task coming up. Bangladesh Women need to bowl really well to keep India on the back foot. Can they though?

A fantastic bowling performance from India and they'll be happy with how the things stand. Renuka Singh had an off day at the office but Pooja Vastrakar put her hand up to build the pressure early on. However, it was the spinners who got 7 out of 10 wickets. The likes of Radha Yadav, Shreyanka Patil and Deepti Sharma were right on the money giving nothing away.

Commentary.Commentary: All set for action. The players are out in the middle. Renuka Singh has the new ball in hand. Dilara Akter and Murshida Khatun to open for Bangladesh. Let's go...

Harmanpreet Kaur says they were looking to bowl first. Adds they were not able to execute in the final few overs with the bat and hopes to do well. Shares Dayalan Hemalatha is back in the team, she has scored a lot of runs recently and that will give her confidence. Mentions she tries to stay fit and then contribute to the team in any way possible.

Nigar Sultana says they will bat first as it is a good wicket and it allows the batters to play freely. Adds she has faith in the team and potential to bounce back. Shares she doesn't have any target but want to play with good intent. Informs they have made one change.

It is time for the second T20I between Bangladesh and India. The first one ended as we expected it to, the visitors won it quite convincingly and we expect them to dominate yet again. Bangladesh however, would hope to  put up a better show and level the series. A win for India will see them move closer to clinching it. Let's hope for close encounter. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
... MATCH DAY ...

We are awaiting match 2 of the T20I series between Bangladesh and India women. The venue for this clash is Sylhet and it is expected to be a very thrilling clash. India have the early lead in the series as they emerged victorious in the first match. It was a team batting effort by the Women in Blue. Smriti Mandhana couldn't find her form and was dismissed early but the likes of Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia and Harmanpreet Kaur built some good partnerships and stabilized the innings. Richa Ghosh gave a good end, hitting some impressive boundaries along with Sajeevan Sajana to get to a good total. Their bowlers also impressed with brilliant execution of the plan. Renuka Singh clinched three wickets followed by Pooja Vastrakar who got two to her name. The others also got a wicket each and sealed the game in their favour. The home team would be unhappy with the way they performed in the first encounter and will be looking for payback. Rabeya Khan and Marufa Akter bowled well, taking three wickets and two wickets respectively. However, the others couldn't step up and break partnerships at crucial intervals and allowed the opposition to get to a good total. Their batters tried to play some rash shots and gave away some early wickets, putting pressure on the middle and lower order. Dilara Akter, Murshida Khatun and Sobhana Mostary fell early in the innings but the way Nigar Sultana, their skipper handled the pressure was commendable. She got a fine half-century to her name but didn't receive much support from the others. Only 3 batters from their side managed to get to double digit scores which in turn put them on the losing side. This is a chance for the home team to even the scores by a win so make sure to tune in for an exciting encounter between these two teams.
